title: Genomic DNA Extraction Protocol
author: Michael Burgis
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bwx3pfqn

steps.title: Prepare buffers
steps.instruction: Make the following autoclaved buffers: TEN Buffer (10 mM Tris‑HCl, 10 mM EDTA, 150 mM NaCl); SDS‑EB Buffer (2 % SDS, 400 mM NaCl, 40 mM EDTA, 100 mM Tris‑HCl, pH 8.0); TE Buffer (10 mM Tris‑HCl, pH 8.0, 1 mM EDTA, pH 8.0).

steps.title: Pellet overnight culture
steps.instruction: Transfer 10 mL of an overnight algae or cyanobacteria culture into a 15 mL Falcon tube and centrifuge at 5,000 g.

steps.title: Wash cells with TEN buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 5 mL TEN Buffer, vortex briefly, spin for 10 seconds, then aspirate and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Lyse cells with SDS‑EB buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cells in 150 µL H₂O on ice, add 300 µL SDS‑EB Buffer, and vortex to mix.

steps.title: Phenol‑chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add 3.5 mL phenol/chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (1:1), vortex for a few minutes, centrifuge 5 minutes, and transfer the aqueous phase to a new Falcon tube.

steps.title: Chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add 3 mL chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1), vortex briefly, centrifuge, and transfer the aqueous phase to a new tube.

steps.title: Repeat extractions for purity
steps.instruction: Repeat the phenol‑chloroform extraction followed by the chloroform extraction once more to maximize DNA purity.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 2 volumes absolute ethanol to the aqueous phase, incubate on ice for 30 minutes, centrifuge 10 minutes, then wash the pellet once with 200 µL 70 % ethanol.

steps.title: Dry pellet and resuspend in TE
steps.instruction: Dry the pellet at 60 °C until all ethanol has evaporated, then resuspend in the desired volume of TE Buffer.

steps.title: Incubate to dissolve DNA
steps.instruction: Incubate the suspension at 50 °C for 1–2 hours (or overnight) to ensure complete resuspension.

steps.title: Assess DNA quality and quantity
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration and purity using a NanoDrop spectrophotometer.
